headline: DoorDash (DASH) Just Won FAA Approval And Launched Its Own Drone Delivery Service
summary: DoorDash, ticker NasdaqGS:DASH, has received FAA Part 135 certification to operate commercial drone deliveries in the US. The company is launching DoorDash Air as an in house drone delivery program, expanding beyond prior third party drone partnerships. The new service is intended to support mid range deliveries and offer merchants and customers an additional fulfillment option.
